display.purpose: Streak numbers, empty-state headlines, stats heroes. Nunito 800.

headline.purpose: Screen titles: Today, Tomorrow, Registry, Stats.

body.purpose: Task titles at 17px on phone; notes and stats at 15px.

label.purpose: Uppercase buttons and chips. Nunito 800, 0.05em tracking.

shadows.name: outline
shadows.purpose: Task rows, cards, heatmap cells at rest. Prefer border: 2px solid #E5E5E5.

shadows.name: lip-2-swan
shadows.purpose: Ghost buttons, task rows, add rows.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs only. Never on list chrome.

motion.name: motion-none
motion.purpose: Add-row Enter, keyboard complete, keyboard nav.

motion.name: ease-out-strong
motion.purpose: Default UI ease-out (Emil). Enter and press.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Go action: complete, sign in, empty CTA. 3D lip, uppercase Nunito 800.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #58CC02; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 20px; min-height: 50px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #58A700; font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #58A700; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1CB0F6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Move actions. Snow fill, Swan outline and 2px lip.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1CB0F6; padding: 14px 20px; min-height: 50px; border: 2px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #E5E5E5; font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #E5E5E5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1CB0F6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Task Row
components.css: .ds-task { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #4B4B4B; border: 2px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #E5E5E5; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-task-check { width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 2px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #E5E5E5; flex: none; } .ds-task-title { flex: 1; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-chip-upcoming { background: #DDF4FF; color: #1899D6; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Overdue Task Row
components.description: Missed committed work. Walking Fish wash, Cardinal chip.
components.css: .ds-task-overdue { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #FFDFE0; color: #4B4B4B; border: 2px solid #FFB2B2; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #FFB2B2; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-task-overdue .ds-task-check { width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 2px solid #FFB2B2; border-radius: 9999px; flex: none; } .ds-task-overdue .ds-task-title { flex: 1; font-size: 17px; } .ds-chip-overdue { background: #FF4B4B; color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Add Row
components.description: Always-on capture. Instant on Enter. Macaw focus.
components.css: .ds-add { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FFFFFF; color: #4B4B4B; border: 2px dashed #E5E5E5; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-add::placeholder { color: #AFAFAF; } .ds-add:focus { outline: none; border-style: solid; border-color: #1CB0F6; background: #DDF4FF; }

components.name: Streak Pill
components.description: Header streak. Fox number, Canary wash. Geometric flame, not an owl.
components.css: .ds-streak { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #FFF5D3; border: 2px solid #FFC800; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-streak-mark { width: 12px; height: 16px; background: #FF9600; border-radius: 8px 8px 4px 4px; } .ds-streak-n { color: #4B4B4B; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.description: Today, Tomorrow, Registry, Stats. Bottom bar on phone; 72px left rail at 1024px+. Active Feather, inactive Hare.
components.html: TODAYTOMORROWREGISTRYSTATS
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; align-items: center; background: #FFFFFF; border-top: 2px solid #E5E5E5; height: 64px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { color: #AFAFAF; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #58CC02; }

narrative.overview: stasks should feel like a grown-up arcade for getting through the day. You open it in bed to plan tomorrow, tap chunky keys, watch a streak tick, and close it. It is a product UI wearing Duolingo’s public visual language: vivid animal-named color, rounded type, hard 3D lips instead of blurry shadows, white-dominant surfaces, one obvious action. Inspired by Duolingo, not a clone. No Duo, no wordmark, no Feather Bold, no DIN Next Rounded.
keyCharacteristics: Feather Green for go / complete / streak heat; never as body text
3D key buttons: solid 0 4px 0 lip; press = translateY(4px) + lip to 0
2px Swan outlines on rows and cards; no soft drop shadows on lists
Personal = green family, Work = Macaw family
Overdue = Cardinal chip; Upcoming = Macaw chip
Heatmap uses the green ramp with GitHub grammar

rules.name: The Green-Means-Go Rule
rules.body: If a control is not the primary action, not a completion, and not streak heat, it is not Feather Green.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Body, titles, and notes are Eel or Wolf on Snow/Polar. Feather Green is a fill, never a paragraph color.

rules.name: The Lip Rule
rules.body: A filled control’s shadow is a solid offset of its darker sibling, 4px, zero blur. Ghost controls use Swan 0 2px 0.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: No 300, no 500. Emphasis is 800. Reading is 400.

rules.name: The Numbers Rule
rules.body: Streak, best streak, heatmap totals, completion counts: Display 800, never caption.

rules.name: The Hard-Lip Rule
rules.body: If it is pressable, it has a lip in a darker shade of itself. If it is a container, it has a 2px Swan outline. Not both mixed with blur.

dos: Do use Nunito 400/800 self-hosted with next/font. Cite OFL in the repo.
Do give every pressable filled control a 4px solid lip in Tree Frog / Whale / Fire Ant and 150ms key travel.
Do outline rows with 2px Swan, not blur.
Do set ink to Eel, secondary to Wolf, canvas to Polar, cards to Snow.
Do use Feather Green only for go: complete, primary CTA, active tab, heatmap heat, Personal accent.
Do mark Work with Macaw and overdue with a labeled Cardinal chip (not color alone).
Do shout on buttons (uppercase 800) and speak in sentence case on headlines.
Do keep add-row and keyboard paths instant.
Do celebrate the first complete of the day and streak milestones 7/30/100. Tick the number on other days.
Do keep one primary green action per screen.
donts: Don't use Duo, the Duolingo wordmark, Feather Bold, or DIN Next Rounded.
Don't load Google Fonts from the CDN at runtime.
Don't use Linear / Notion / Todoist gray SaaS chrome, tiny Inter, or hairline cards.
Don't look like Apple Reminders or stock iOS lists.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradient text, hero-metric templates, identical icon-card grids, or sidebar color stripes.
Don't ship dark-mode purple / neon productivity gamification.
Don't shame. No Failed, no sad mascot, no guilt copy.
Don't put body text on Feather Green. Don't use #000000.
Don't use blurred drop shadows where a lip or 2px outline belongs.
Don't mix radii at random. 8 chips, 12 controls, 16 panels, pill for bars/badges.
Don't animate Enter-to-add or other 100+/day actions.
Don't fire the milestone celebration every complete.
